svg.title: படம் 2-10: KV Cache முன்னொட்டு மறுபயன்பாட்டு பொறிமுறை
svg.desc: Three requests compare KV Cache prefix reuse: Request 1 establishes the cache; Request 2 hits it because the prefix is unchanged; Request 3 puts a dynamic timestamp at the start of the system prompt, so every token after the change point is recomputed and billed again.
